# hermes-lcm v0.21.0-rc3

Experimental Lossless Context Management release candidate focused on async background compaction and publish-ready operator guidance.

## Highlights

- Adds opt-in async background compaction: LCM can prepare summary batches after completed turns instead of doing all summarization at the foreground threshold.
- Publishes prepared summaries atomically only at safe foreground boundaries, preserving raw-message recovery and active-context consistency.
- Keeps the release conservative: async compaction is default-off, optional memory/retrieval feature families stay default-off, and SQLite raw history remains recoverable.

## Changes

- Adds compaction-batch and pending-summary storage, bounded worker controls, stale-batch recovery, retry backoff, and profile/session ownership fences.
- Documents `LCM_ASYNC_BACKGROUND_COMPACTION_*` settings and the recommended cheap `auxiliary.compression` model chain.
- Adds focused regression coverage for async preparation, publication, recovery, and race-safety paths.
